title: 🔬 Table 2: AI Framework / Runtime Polyglot Table
scope: **Repository scope:** This is an ecosystem comparison, not an inventory of runtimes implemented or validated here. Export and compatibility checks do not establish IPU execution. Poplar.NET records qualification on the WSL IPU Model as completed, while physical-IPU and multi-IPU qualification remain open; treat other framework, runtime, and hardware entries as general reference claims.

title: 📊 Table 4: Data Types & Precision Polyglot Table
scope: This is a cross-ecosystem reference table, not a repository capability matrix. In this repository, the tabular ML.NET path handles numeric, Boolean, and string columns; its ONNX tests exercise float and string inputs, with Boolean conversion covered by model-export tests. The managed Poplar wrapper exposes Float, Half, Int, and UnsignedInt tensor types. The table's framework spellings, ranges, and precision figures are general reference entries and do not establish repository support or validation for every listed type or framework.

title: 🔧 Table 5: Hardware Accelerator Polyglot Table
scope: Repository scope: this is a general ecosystem comparison, not a validated hardware compatibility or performance matrix. Source-backed examples here include the GraphRAG CPU SIMD vector-search implementation, an Intel Level Zero GPU vector-search backend that probes availability and can fall back, ONNX Runtime session construction for text embeddings without explicit accelerator-provider selection in this source, and managed Poplar bindings. These paths do not verify every vendor row, ONNX provider claim, power figure, or physical-device execution; Poplar wrapper and model code alone do not establish real-IPU availability.

title: 📁 Table 6: ML Model Format Polyglot Table
scope: Repository scope: this is a general format comparison, not a capability matrix for this repository. The tabular AutoML exporter writes an ML.NET `model.zip` and can export `model.onnx`; tests cover reloading the ML.NET artifact and ONNX Runtime score parity for selected models. The local L0 LLM path accepts Safetensors model directories and GGUF checkpoints, with GGUF architecture support constrained by the implemented tensor mapping. The other rows describe ecosystem formats and are not evidence of repository import, export, interoperability, or hardware support.
